# Elephant-Goldfish Model for DeepSeek Harness
Ever read a design doc and realized a crucial detail only made sense because you were there for the
discussion? That’s the idea behind Elephant-Goldfish.
The Elephant is the DSH session you’ve been working in. It knows the tradeoffs you discussed and hel
ps turn them into a design. The Goldfish are reviewers that each start in a fresh conversation. They
get the draft and the files they need to review it, so they can spot gaps your original session mig
and the files they need to review it, so they can spot gaps your original session might gloss over.
## Get started

1. Download the `.tgz` from the latest release.
2. In DSH, open **Plugin Hub → Add**, choose the fil

e, and enable the plugin.
3. Open the composer and type `/egm` to see the commands.
Already have a design doc? Try `/egm-review design.md`. For example, if you’re designing a backgroun
d job that retries, see whether the draft explains what happens when a job runs twice or stops halfw
retries, see whether the draft explains what happens when a job runs twice or stops halfway through.
EGM works on its own inside DSH. You don’t need any other plugins. The commands were verified on DSH
`0.2.2-alpha.3`. For Goldfish reviews, use a preset that exposes DSH’s built-in `subagent` tool wit
h fresh conversations. How reviews run in DSH
## The seven commands
| Command | When to use it |

| `/egm-brainstorm` | You have an idea and want to work out what to build. |
| `/egm-draft` | You ha

ve notes or a brief and want to turn them into a design doc. |
| `/egm-review` | You have a draft an

d want to put it through the five-stage review. |
| `/egm-review-loop` | You want to pick the review

ers and standards for a document review. |
| `/egm-resolve` | You have review findings and want to d

ecide which changes to make. |
| `/egm-bootstrap` | You want to document how part of an existing rep

o works. |
| `/egm-drift-report` | You want to see where the code and design docs have diverged. |
## Working on the plugin
Run `npm test` to check command registration and bundled files. Run `npm pack` to build a tarball yo
u can install in DSH.
This is my DSH port of Google’s Elephant-Goldfish Model. It includes the upstream reviewer personas
and standards. Upstream revision · License
